caseNameFull: Louis B. Nagler v. United States

opinions.text: Error to the District Court of the United States for the Western District of Wisconsin. October 20, 1920. Judgment reversed, on confession of error, and cause remanded for further proceedings in conformity with law, on motion of The Solicitor General for the United States. Mr. Gilbert E. Roe and Mr. Herman L. Ekem for plaintiff-in error.
